licensed.notes: Calculate BOM: nothing goes to the service until the floating Calculate BOM button is pressed (drag it anywhere; Auto restores costing on every change). An earlier stage that carries BOPP takes the BOPP share; BOPP-to-metallised adhesive lamination suggested from the three GSM shares; metres for any film spelling. Chat: Show one person, Clear one person. The register moved to BOM Records. Every table sorts on its headers. A golden-arrow window opened over another comes back to it on Close.
